name: Cool-down
description: Slow floor stretches and breathing to bring your heart rate down after training. Hold each position softly, there is nothing to push.

items.cue: Sink back and slow your breathing.
Rest on the forearms, relax the glutes.
Rest on the forearms and let the hip settle.
Keep the other leg relaxed, ease the leg closer on exhales.
Draw the knee toward the opposite shoulder.
Both shoulders stay heavy on the floor.
Soles together, let the knees fall open.
Legs rest on the wall, arms out, breathe slowly.
Let your whole body go heavy. Long, slow exhales.
